policy.batch_rule: issueを出す -> 全部消す -> issueを出す
policy.required_for: All open CFB/CFR detail issue files must have an issue entry with root_cause, fix_group, target_version, owner_module, close_evidence, and next_plan_mapping.
policy.close_rule: An issue can move to fixed only after the detail file, summary index, cycle plan, history, and evidence links agree.

next_plan_mapping.decision: Use this machine-readable map plus a docs consistency test as the root-cause mapping source of truth for future open CFB/CFR batches.
